title: mol-do-work
description:
Simple work formula — read the bead, do what it says, close it.

This is the minimal work lifecycle for coding agents. No git branching,
no worktree isolation, no refinery handoff. The agent reads the bead's
description, implements the solution in the current working directory,
and closes the bead when done.

Use this for demos and simple single-agent workflows. For production
multi-agent setups with branch isolation and merge review, use
mol-polecat-work instead.

## Variables

| Variable | Source | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| issue | caller | The work bead ID assigned to this agent |

title: Read assignment, implement, and close
description:
You have been assigned a work bead. Read it, do the work, and close it.

**1. Read your assignment:**
```bash
bd show ac-1po
```

Read the bead's title and description carefully. This is your task.

**2. Implement the solution:**

Do exactly what the bead describes. Follow existing codebase conventions.
Make atomic, focused commits as you work:
```bash
git add <files>
git commit -m "<type>: <description>"
```

**3. Close the bead when done:**
```bash
bd update ac-1po --status=closed --notes "Done: <brief summary of what you did>"
```

If you get stuck or need clarification, check your inbox:
```bash
gc mail inbox
```

**Exit criteria:** The work described in the bead is complete and the bead is closed.

title: Signal completion
description:
Work is done. Signal the controller to reclaim this session:

```bash

```

title: Rename packages: ig → meta and free → free-media-upload
description:
Rename two provider packages in /Users/jwt/apicity:

1. packages/provider/ig → packages/provider/meta
   - Package name: @apicity/ig → @apicity/meta
2. packages/provider/free → packages/provider/free-media-upload
   - Package name: @apicity/free → @apicity/free-media-upload

For each rename, update ALL references across the monorepo:
- Directory path
- package.json 'name' field
- All import statements / package specifiers in TS/JS files
- Workspace config (root package.json, bun/pnpm workspace files, tsconfig refs)
- README files, docs, generated tables (note: root README has a packages table)
- Any internal cross-package dependencies
- MCP server registrations if applicable
- Tests and fixtures

After the rename, run the build and any tests to confirm nothing is broken. Use git mv where possible to preserve history. Do both renames in a single commit/PR.
notes: Renamed packages: ig → meta and free → free-media-upload. Updated all references, rebuilt, all 2443 tests pass.
